caveats: Local dev browser verification; external CI, Pages deployment, and online production URL validation remain separate completion criteria.
Scoped source filter reuses the global hot query complete certificate plus proof catalog/source manifest metadata; it no longer reads full shards for the verified JWC score scenario.
Attachment verification accepts visible attachment filename/type/page metadata labels and separately rejects explicit attachment-body coverage claims.
Route replacement is a browser stale-state guard; AbortController cancellation remains covered by unit/runtime tests.
Screenshot capture timed out through the Browser backend; this run does not use screenshots as completion evidence.
